text: Which plasma membrane proteins are T-cell-specific in the single-cell data and enriched in the T-cell lineage?
plan: Subcellular location (ICC): Plasma membrane AND Cell type category (scRNA): T-cells / Cell type enriched AND Immune cell lineage category (RNA): T-cells / Lineage enriched
understanding: The query asks for genes coding for proteins localized to the plasma membrane that are specifically expressed in T-cells based on single-cell RNA-seq data, and are also classified as enriched in the T-cell lineage within immune cell data.

trail.why: The requirement specifies plasma membrane proteins without restricting reliability, cell-cycle status, or annotation classes.

The requirement asks for T-cell specificity in single-cell data, which corresponds to selecting 'T-cells' at Level 1 and 'Cell type enriched' (defined as at least four-fold higher mRNA level compared to any other cell type) at Level 2.
The requirement specifies enrichment in the T-cell lineage, which corresponds to selecting 'T-cells' at Level 1 and 'Lineage enriched' at Level 2.

requirements.why: This field specifies experimental subcellular localization by ICC, which includes the 'Plasma membrane' option, whereas 'Predicted location' only has general membrane predictions and 'Protein class' has 'Plasma proteins' which refers to blood plasma rather than cell plasma membrane.
This field captures RNA specificity categories (such as cell type specific/enriched) across single cell types from single-cell RNA-seq data, specifically for 'T-cells'.
This field classifies RNA specificity across immune cell lineages, with options for 'T-cells' and categories such as 'Lineage enriched'.
